description: Server-push updates merged into the Svelte 5 data grid by id. A long-lived connection streams row-level change events, insert with a row, update with an id and a patch, and delete with an id, and the client merges them into the local dataset so only affected rows re-render. getRowId keeps identity stable, updated cells flash yellow and fade, and controls pause and resume the stream and set throughput from 1 to 30 events per second; replace mockSocket with a WebSocket or EventSource and the merge stays the same.

faq.question: How are events merged without reloading the list?
faq.answer: Rows are kept in a map by id. insert adds a row, update applies the patch to the existing object and delete removes it; the grid receives the new array and, thanks to getRowId, only re-renders rows whose object changed.

faq.question: How is the cell flash done?
faq.answer: The merge records a timestamp per updated cell keyed by row id and field; cellClass adds a flash class while the entry is younger than 1100 ms, and a polling tick re-evaluates so the class drops off when the time is up.

faq.question: What changes for a real WebSocket?
faq.answer: Only the source. Wire socket.onmessage to parse the event and call the same merge function; the pause buffer, throughput and log work unchanged.
